_comment: Example scenario for `python3 -m code4me_e2e run --scenario scenario.example.json`. Every key is optional; the harness has the same defaults built in. Keys beginning with `_` or `$` are documentation only. Override any value from the CLI with `--set dotted.key=value`.

stack._comment: The harness's own disposable docker-compose stack.

admin._comment: A fresh admin account the harness creates; there is no admin endpoint, so `grant_roles` promotes it via SQL. Emails must use a normal TLD (`.test` is rejected by EmailStr).
admin.name: E2E Admin

study.name: E2E Synthetic Study
study.description: Synthetic study created by the code4me-e2e harness.

agent._probe_comment: Inputs of the standalone agent-probe only (--layer agents runs both frameworks and uses discovery plus CODE4ME_E2E_<FRAMEWORK>_EXECUTABLE). executable replaces discovery; agent_command/agent_package name the agent like a BYOA release; agent_command_args replaces the default ACP argv; agent_home replaces the isolated per-run home (must be empty).

message._comment: expected_substring null means: assert the stub provider's own deterministic token.
message.prompt: Say hello in one short sentence.
